messages.text:
Hi! I’m Tatsuya from Japan. I’m very interested in your room. Here are my details:
1. Move in: Immediately
2. Inspection: Free anytime this week & weekend! (Today/Tomorrow ok)
3. Stay: At least 6 months
4. About me:
I am a Japanese male on a working holiday visa. I am very clean, organized, and a non-smoker who respects house rules and others' privacy. I have enough savings to pay rent on time, and I am planning to work in a cafe during the day. I am friendly but also value a quiet and peaceful living environment.
I can come for an inspection even today or tomorrow if you are available. Looking forward to hearing from you!
Thanks,
Tatsuya
Sorry, would it be possible to reschedule for tomorrow?
Thanks, I appreciate it. Please let me know.
